title: sprite
summary: A single image (or one frame of a spritesheet) drawn at the entity position.

title: animatedSprite
summary: A spritesheet with named animations. Animations are declared in the texture's `.meta.json` (`anims`).

title: text
summary: World-space text (Phaser Text). For HUD text prefer `uiLabel`.

title: tilemap
summary: A grid of tiles from a tileset image. Loads Tiled JSON (`.tmj`/`.json`) or Nord simple maps (`layers[].data`).

title: parallax
summary: A screen-filling background layer that scrolls slower than the camera for depth.

title: particles
summary: Particle emitter. 2D (Phaser emitter) and 3D (Babylon ParticleSystem) use the same component with tier-specific fields.

title: camera
summary: 2D: configures the main camera (zoom, follow, bounds). 3D: creates a free (first-person) or orbit camera.

title: light
summary: 2D: Phaser point light (turns on the light pipeline for all sprites). 3D: point / directional / spot / hemispheric light, optional shadows.

title: mesh
summary: A primitive 3D shape (box, sphere, cylinder, capsule, torus, plane, ground).

title: model
summary: A glTF/GLB model instanced into the scene, with its animations.

title: material
summary: PBR (or unlit) material applied to the meshes of this entity.

title: skybox
summary: Cube-map sky. `path` is a folder containing px/nx/py/ny/pz/nz.png (e.g. `assets/skybox/day`).

title: postProcess
summary: Full-screen effects on the active camera: bloom, FXAA/MSAA, vignette, tone mapping, grain, sharpen, chromatic aberration.

title: rigidbody
summary: Makes the entity a physics body. Add a `collider` for its shape.

title: collider
summary: Collision shape. Without an explicit `size` it is taken from the sprite/mesh bounds.

title: joint
summary: A Unity-style joint between this body and `connectedBody` (or the world): hinge, spring, distance, fixed, slider, wheel, target, relative, friction (2D, Matter) and hinge, fixed, spring, distance, ball (CharacterJoint), configurable (3D, Havok).

title: trigger
summary: Shorthand for a collider with `trigger: true` — an invisible zone that fires `onTriggerEnter` / `onTriggerExit`.

title: lineRenderer
summary: A poly-line drawn as a ribbon with a width and a colour gradient (Unity's LineRenderer).

title: trailRenderer
summary: Leaves a fading trail behind a moving entity (Unity's TrailRenderer).

title: spriteMask
summary: Shows or hides sprites inside its shape (Unity's SpriteMask).

title: spriteShape
summary: A filled shape with an edge line from a list of points (Unity's SpriteShape: hills, platforms, pools).

title: shadertoy
summary: Runs a shader written for shadertoy.com (GLSL ES 3.00 `mainImage`) as a picture in the scene or on a mesh.

title: audioSource
summary: Plays a clip from an entity. Use `bus` to route it (sfx | music | ui).

title: audioListener
summary: Marker for the entity that "hears" the game. Currently a no-op placeholder (audio is not spatialised yet).

title: uiPanel
summary: A background box in the DOM UI layer.

title: uiLabel
summary: Text in the DOM UI layer.

title: uiImage
summary: An image in the DOM UI layer.

title: uiBar
summary: A progress bar (0..1).

title: uiButton
summary: A clickable button. Emits `click` on the entity, calls `onClick()` on its scripts and, if `event` is set, `game.events.emit(event)`.

title: path
summary: A list of waypoints that can be sampled by distance — for patrols, moving platforms, camera rails.

title: spawner
summary: Spawns a prefab every `interval` seconds at the entity (plus `offset` and random `jitter`), keeping at most `max` alive.

title: graph
summary: Runs a visual-scripting graph file (`graphs/*.graph.json`) on this entity. *This entity* in the graph is the owner. Built in the Graph tab.

title: animator
summary: Unity-style state machine (`anim/*.animator.json`) that switches the clip of the `animatedSprite` (or the glTF animation of the `model`) on the same entity from parameters (float, int, bool, trigger). Built in the Animator tab; see the Animator chapter.

title: netSync
summary: Multiplayer: the owning peer sends this entity's position (and optionally rotation, scale and chosen `vars`) to everyone else, who see it move smoothly. Owner = the player given to `net.spawn`, otherwise the host. Needs `game.net` connected; see the Multiplayer chapter.
